title: Clock and Orchard
author: Noor Halloran
blurb: Cyrus Vane, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
